newsitem.title: FRANCE: Timing of Eurotunnel statement uncertain.
newsitem.headline: Timing of Eurotunnel statement uncertain.

text.p: A statement from the president of the Paris commercial court, Jean-Pierre Mattei, on Eurotunnel SA /Plc may be made either later on Tuesday evening or Wednesday.
An assistant to the magistrate handling Mattei's communications told Reuters the statement might be made "this evening or tomorrow morning." She gave no further details.
Earlier, a court official said Mattei would issue a statement, probably on Tuesday, but gave no details of its contents, which are expected to deal with Eurotunnel's debt negotiations.
Eurotunnel is trying to reach an agreement with bankers on a refinancing of some 70 billion francs ($13.6 billion) in debt and unpaid interest. ($ = 5.150 French Francs)
